name: StatCards
deprecation_reason: Generic count-up presentation has no Shopify scope and should be authored in the page section.
usage_hint: Animated stat cards that count up on scroll. Renders percentage/number statistics with configurable layout and visual style. Perfect as overlay cards on hero sections or standalone social proof rows.
when_to_use: For displaying key metrics (conversion rates, customer counts, satisfaction scores) that benefit from scroll-triggered count-up animation. Use on hero overlays, trust sections, or above-the-fold proof points.
when_not_to_use: For static numbers that don't need animation (use plain HTML). For live/real-time data that updates continuously (use a dashboard widget). For single isolated stats (overkill — use inline text).
anti_patterns: Too many items (>6): overwhelming and dilutes impact — pick top 3-4 metrics
Placing below fold where animation isn't seen on first load (defeats the purpose of count-up)
Using with animate:false AND glass style (static glass cards look like broken UI without the reveal)
Decimal values with long suffixes (e.g. 99.87% satisfaction) — round for impact
